WHAT IS THIS?

A playful way to understand PISA results

This is an interactive learning world built around the 2025 PISA data. Start with Malaysia, visit country pavilions and compare results with context. It is not a ranking game and it does not explain why countries score differently.

All four subject scores

Scores are scale points, not percentages. Different subjects have distinct scales. Gaps use rounded scores and are not significance tests. Missing values never mean zero. * OECD sampling caution.

WELCOME, EXPLORER

Your learning garden

Tap a pavilion or its name. The camera moves closer and follows your avatar to the pavilion, then opens the results. Use Reset camera (↺) to return to the overview. Tap open ground to walk freely.

Drag to rotate the view. Pinch or use + / − to zoom. On a keyboard, focus the scene then use W A S D or the arrow keys to walk.

The four coloured gateways change the subject. Region portals and the region selector take you to other campuses. Use the arrows to visit the next set of pavilions.

Buildings have equal size and do not encode performance. This is a fictional learning space, not a geographical map. Scores, missing values and caveats come from the existing snapshot.
